Comparison

The best Brightwheel alternatives in 2026

An honest comparison for owner-operated daycares — including our own app, clearly labelled.

Brightwheel is a capable platform — but quote-gated pricing that commonly lands at $150–$400+/month, payment-processing cuts, and big-customer support queues send plenty of owners looking. Here are the six alternatives worth your time. Full disclosure: Mitten (#1) is our product — we've kept the comparison honest anyway.

1. Mitten — best for owner-operated daycares (that's us)

Free for your first 5 children, then $20/mo + $2 per child (a 20-child program pays ~$48/mo — published right here, no sales call). Daily photo feeds with per-family privacy, AI-drafted notes and parent recaps included free, milestones & memory books, messaging, attendance, lesson plans, profitability analytics, payroll prep from tracked hours, and encrypted employee onboarding. Canadian-built; your data is never sold and exports anytime; parents need no app-store download. Where we're honest about fit: Mitten is built for single-site, owner-operated programs — large multi-site chains needing subsidy-agency administration are better on Procare or Kangarootime. Start free → or poke the live demo (no signup).

2. Lillio (HiMama) — best for documentation-led programs

Canadian roots and the deepest child-development documentation culture. Commonly ~$100–$300+/mo by quote. Pick it if learning stories are the centre of your practice and budget isn't tight. Full Lillio guide →

3. Procare — best for enterprise administration

The veteran. Unmatched billing/subsidy administration for big centres; heavier and costlier than small programs need. Full Procare guide →

4. Famly — best interface of the big platforms

Genuinely lovely UX with occupancy planning; European centre of gravity, ~$100–$250/mo for small centres by quote. Full Famly guide →

5. Kangarootime — best for multi-site groups

Automation for chains: subsidies, scheduling, multi-location dashboards. Overkill for one site. Full guide →

6. Daily Connect — best on a shoestring

A simple, inexpensive daily-log app (roughly ~$1–$2/child/mo as commonly reported). Great if all you need is logging; you'll outgrow it the day you want billing, payroll or analytics.

Frequently asked questions

What is the cheapest Brightwheel alternative?
For very small programs, Mitten is free up to 5 children; beyond that it’s $20/mo + $2 per child — typically a fraction of Brightwheel’s commonly reported $150–$400+/mo. Daily Connect is also inexpensive if you only need daily logging.
Can I switch from Brightwheel mid-year?
Yes — the practical path is to run both for one week while families move over. Mitten migrates your roster free, and parents join via a link with no app-store download, which makes the switch week dramatically easier.
